The '''moon''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Useria]] was the site of the [[Lunar Gardens]], a legendary garden that was in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Excavation of the Gardens during the Cold War discovered a cache of valuable specimens.
